prompt: Repair persisted Target projection compatibility, prove list and Workbench availability across legacy and corrupt snapshots, verify the combined B2/B3 stack, and prepare an inspectable merge-readiness decision without committing or merging.
allowed_actions: Add strict shared Target read-model schemas and a bounded legacy compatibility upgrader
Add projection integrity checks, corrupt-list isolation, stable detail errors, and operational logging
Extend service, route, UI, Go, and integration tests
Update canonical projection-evolution and development documentation
Run local services, Temporal, browser verification, and repository checks
Create B2.1 run receipts, evidence, timeline, and an advisory review decision
forbidden_actions: Treat malformed JSON as a native Target
Change Target authority, Acceptance, or Graph semantics
Hide missing evidence or inherited failures
Commit, merge, push, deploy, release, or create a ship record without explicit user approval
validation_commands: pnpm exec vitest run packages/shared/src/validators/target.test.ts server/src/__tests__/target-read-model.test.ts server/src/__tests__/target-routes.test.ts server/src/__tests__/verrail-domain-api.integration.test.ts ui/src/components/NewTargetDialog.test.tsx ui/src/components/TargetList.test.tsx ui/src/pages/TargetWorkbench.test.tsx ui/src/pages/VerrailHome.test.tsx ui/src/App.test.tsx
expected_evidence: Legacy and corrupt projection database tests
Stable API error and list isolation tests
Desktop and narrow browser interaction evidence
Same-database Target outbox and Temporal delivery evidence or an explicit remaining gate
Advisory merge-readiness review with no self-approval
stop_conditions: Compatibility requires inventing business facts or weakening authorization
A read path would need to mutate an immutable snapshot
Native Target write authority would move outside Go
The observed failure is not bounded to a known legacy shape and cannot fail closed
